steps.label: What it is
steps.why: The white matter branches into every fold of the cerebellum, so a cut section looks like a tree.
common_mistakes: Calling it grey matter. Arbor vitae is white matter.
Placing it in the cerebrum. It is in the cerebellum.
steps.memory_tip: Arbor means tree: white matter branching like a tree.
steps.margin_note: Name the tissue and the shape.

steps.label: Where it is
steps.why: The grey matter lies on the outside of the cerebellum, so the white tree is enclosed by it.
common_mistakes: Writing that grey matter lies inside it. The grey cortex is outside.
steps.memory_tip: White tree inside, grey cortex outside.

lines.text: Grey matter, the cerebellar cortex, surrounds it

insider_note: Two marks for two facts: the tree-shaped white matter, and that it sits inside the cerebellum surrounded by grey matter.
